user.title: Put the Vent-Axia unit into pairing mode
user.description: On the unit, press the Mode button once to wake the display. Press and hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. The LED will flash blue while Bluetooth pairing mode is active. Select Submit to scan for the unit.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: On the unit, press the Mode button once to wake the display. Press and hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. While the LED is flashing blue, select Submit. No PIN is required; Home Assistant will complete the MEV pairing exchange automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the unit again
reauth_confirm.description: Press Mode once to wake the display. Hold Mode until the LED lights solid blue, then release it. While the LED is flashing blue, select Submit. No PIN is required.

error.pairing_failed: The MEV pairing exchange failed. Confirm that the unit's LED is flashing blue, then try again.

calibrate_co2.title: Choose a CO₂ calibration method
calibrate_co2.description: Calibration changes the accuracy of future CO₂ readings. Fresh-air exposure is the recommended method. A Home Assistant reference sensor should be used only when you know it is a trusted, recently calibrated, true CO₂ sensor.

calibration_exposure.title: Prepare fresh-air exposure
calibration_exposure.description:
1. Open external windows and doors in every room from which the MEV extracts air.
2. Ventilate for 10–15 minutes.
3. Keep those rooms unoccupied and leave the openings open.
4. Select Submit only when preparation is complete.

The reference is fixed at 400 ppm. After final confirmation, Home Assistant will display the MEV manual's three-minute sampling progress. Keep the rooms open and unoccupied until that progress finishes; you do not need to see the loft-mounted unit.

calibration_reference.title: Choose trusted CO₂ references
calibration_reference.description: Select one or more independent Home Assistant CO₂ sensors. Prefer one trusted sensor per extracted room. Home Assistant cannot determine whether a sensor is calibrated, accurate, or reports true CO₂ rather than estimated eCO₂. Keep rooms unoccupied and conditions stable until calibration finishes.

calibration_confirm.title: Confirm CO₂ calibration
calibration_confirm.description:
Device: **{device}**

Calibration target: **internal MEV CO₂ sensor**

Reference: **{reference_ppm} ppm**

{reference_summary}

After confirmation, Home Assistant will track the documented three-minute sampling period. Keep rooms unoccupied and conditions unchanged until its progress finishes. The physical status LED should flash magenta, but you do not need to see the unit. An incorrect reference will make future CO₂ readings inaccurate.

data.confirm_calibration: I have completed the preparation and confirm that the reference is trustworthy

calibration_progress.title: CO₂ calibration in progress
calibration_progress.description: Home Assistant sent the {reference_ppm} ppm command to {device} and is tracking the MEV manual's three-minute internal-sensor sampling period. Keep every extracted room ventilated, unoccupied, and unchanged until the progress bar finishes. Closing this screen does not stop calibration.

calibration_result.title: Sampling period elapsed
calibration_result.description: The MEV manual's three-minute sampling period has elapsed for the {reference_ppm} ppm command sent to {device}. You may now close the windows and use the rooms normally. This Home Assistant timer does not prove firmware completion because the MEV protocol exposes no calibration-status readback.

progress.calibration_sampling: Tracking the three-minute MEV sampling period

error.calibration_failed: The calibration command failed. No success has been recorded; normal polling will retry automatically.
error.calibration_not_supported: Internal CO₂ calibration is not validated for this model.
error.calibration_rate_limited: A calibration was attempted recently. Wait five minutes before trying again.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm the preparation before starting calibration.
error.invalid_reference: Select only numeric CO₂ sensors that report ppm.
error.reference_out_of_range: Every reference reading must be between 400 and 2,000 ppm.
error.reference_unavailable: A selected reference sensor is currently unavailable. No calibration was sent.
error.self_reference: The MEV cannot use its own CO₂ entity as a calibration reference.

abort.calibration_not_supported: Internal CO₂ calibration is not validated for this model. No command was sent.
